last.summary: The BWT spec covers sorted cyclic rotations, valid origin pointers, the decoder-style inverse, declarative inverse statements, and banana/periodic examples. I checked the pointer scan, 24-bit header field, sort fallback, decoder bounds, cftab construction, tt bit layout, and last-column extraction against the vendored C source. The proposed inverse also matched every valid pointer for all blocks of lengths 1–8 over a three-byte alphabet. The change stays within spec/, follows the import and proof-hole rules, and verify.sh passes.
